title: Kissed Yeasty Italian Comte Cacio E Pepe
description: A yeasty, pillowy Italian dish featuring Comte cheese and a yuzu cure, perfect for a diabetic-friendly brunch option.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yuzu juice, yeast, and a pinch of salt to create the yuzu cure.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the grated Comte cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cheese sauce.
Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Drizzle the yuzu cure over the top of the spaghetti and toss to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional black pepper if desired.
